name: Katsuragi (Wakayama, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Katsuragi town emblem in white: a winged device above a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Katsuragi, a town in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1959.

features.role: Katsuragi town emblem — a winged device above a ring
